channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kevin Huerter | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kevin Huerter from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Zach Collins, Kevin Huerter
item.description:
Donovan on Bulls’ inability to uphold their playstyle through recent skid:

“I’m not looking at film saying, ‘Oh, Kevin Huerter’s out, Zach Collins is out. Boy, if HE was here, this would be different.’ I don’t believe that. Some of it’s, like, inbounding the basketball. What do these guys being out have to do with that? What is five guys running back in transition, talking and communicating, have to do with anybody being out?”

Billy Donovan on Zach Collins, Kevin Huerter, Dec 10, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Kevin Huerter, Tony Brothers
item.description:
Billy Donovan on Tony Brothers’ interpretation of the play that saw Kevin Huerter ejected, as relayed to him:

“He felt like (Huerter's) intention was to smack the ball at the official.”

Billy Donovan on Kevin Huerter, Tony Brothers, Nov 21, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Tre Jones, Kevin Huerter, Isaac Okoro
item.description:
“It’s something we talk a lot about. The additions of Tre (Jones) and Kevin (Huerter) last year, they’re such good cutters, and ‘Ice,’ Isaac Okoro, this year, they’re really good cutters, so it adds to our offense.”

Nikola Vucevic on Tre Jones, Kevin Huerter, Isaac Okoro, Oct 25, 2025. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Mike Brown on Kevin Huerter
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Mike Brown on if he's considering moving Kevin Huerter to the second unit:

“I'm not just looking at Kevin and thinking about taking Kevin out of the starting lineup. There are other changes that can be made.”

Mike Brown on Kevin Huerter, Oct 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kevin Huerter
item.description:
Legion Hoops:Kevin Durant on Kevin Huerter:

“He's playing like Klay, Steph. If you're not a basketball fan and locked in on the league, you gotta watch how Kevin Huerter is shooting the ball right now.”

Kevin Durant on Kevin Huerter, Nov 22, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Kevin Huerter
item.description:
Nate McMillan on Kevin Huerter, with the deadline to extend Huerter approaching:

“You hope that we can get Kevin signed and extended and we can move forward, everybody can just start to focus on the season. But that's a situation Kevin and the organization are working out.”

Nate McMillan on Kevin Huerter, Oct 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Trae Young on Kevin Huerter
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:Trae Young on Kevin Huerter:

“He's been doing really good, knocking down shots, being ready and being aggressive... He's been playing great and we're going to need him to continue to do that,if we're going to finish out this series strong.”

Trae Young on Kevin Huerter, Jun 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Trae Young, Kevin Huerter
item.description:
Kevin Chouinard:Travis Schlenk on 92.9 FM confirmed that Trae Young and Kevin Huerter won't play in Vegas:

“Trae and even Kevin, we're not planning on those guys playing... They will participate in practices and things like that.”

Travis Schlenk on Trae Young, Kevin Huerter, Apr 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.
